plan.title: feat(occupancy): live sibling-lease discriminator for primary checkout claims

narratives.Description: Recut of #4445: count live occupancy leases on sibling trees instead of leftover git worktree admin dirs; print the runnable --primary-claim-exception=operator-default-branch form on refusal. Do not add a topology policy producer.
narratives.Origin: Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4445 (REST body + comments; ingest refused missing-pain on 5649572412)
narratives.Overview: Spec is Bound remedy lean 5649622186 (supersedes Stop 1 5649572412), verified-claims 5649623054, synthesis accepted 5649624069. The filed topology:solo / allowPrimaryCheckoutMutation producer cannot bind. Occupancy already claims a standalone primary; leftover GIT_COMMON_DIR/worktrees admin dirs are the tax. Sibling #4444 owns docs/requirements session posture. This story owns occupancy engine files only.
narratives.Decisions: Do not add plan.policy.topology. Keep session:start --primary-claim-exception as the trusted producer (#4266). Spawn payloads still cannot name the exception. Drop adaptive lease-history default. ceremonyDial already exists.

items.title: isContendedPrimaryCheckout is main worktree plus a live occupancy lease on a sibling checkout, not leftover GIT_COMMON_DIR/worktrees admin dirs.
A no-op fails: git worktree add with no sibling lease, and leftover admin dirs after rm -rf until prune, must let mutation session:start claim the primary.
A live sibling lease still refuses primary mutation claim and steal without a trusted argv exception. Same-tree second session still refuses.
primaryClaimRefusal prints the runnable deft session:start --primary-claim-exception=operator-default-branch form, not only the enum values.
Do not add plan.policy.topology or allowPrimaryCheckoutMutation. Keep session:start --primary-claim-exception as the trusted producer. Spawn payloads still cannot name the exception.
Do not add an adaptive lease-history default. Spawn already keeps implement workers on worktrees; no swarm-launch topology refusal. Do not edit #4444 docs-posture surfaces.
Tests cover live-lease vs leftover-admin-dir vs expired sibling lease. CHANGELOG [Unreleased].
